SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT 'A' as FLAG , SEQ , CENTER_CD , MRO_PO_NO , PUR_LINE_NUM , PUR_WH_NO , PUR_WH_LINE_NUM FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_IPGO_IF_R WHERE SEND_YN = 'N' UNION SELECT 'B' as FLAG , SEQ , CENTER_CD , MRO_PO_NO , PUR_LINE_NUM , PUR_WH_NO , PUR_WH_LINE_NUM FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_IPGO_IF WHERE SEND_YN = 'N' AND PUR_WH_DT >= '20190801' ORDER BY FLAG,SEQ,CENTER_CD,MRO_PO_NO,PUR_LINE_NUM,PUR_WH_NO,PUR_WH_LINE_NUM
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SYGP' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(PROC_TYPE,'D') AS STATUS, MRO_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PUR_LINE_NUM AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(ITM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(PUR_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(PUR_WH_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(PUR_WH_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, ISNULL(PUR_WH_DT,' ') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(ERP_RFX_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, PUR_WH_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, PUR_WH_LINE_NUM AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, RO_QTY AS RO_QTY, RO_AMT AS RO_AMT, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK , CENTER_CD AS PLANT FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_IPGO_IF_R WHERE SEQ = $G_RS.SEQ$ AND MRO_PO_NO = '$G_RS.MRO_PO_NO$' AND PUR_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_LINE_NUM$' AND PUR_WH_NO = '$G_RS.PUR_WH_NO$' AND PUR_WH_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_WH_LINE_NUM$' UNION SELECT 'SYGP' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(PROC_TYPE,'D') AS STATUS, MRO_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PUR_LINE_NUM AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(ITM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(PUR_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(PUR_WH_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(PUR_WH_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, ISNULL(PUR_WH_DT,' ') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(ERP_RFX_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, PUR_WH_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, PUR_WH_LINE_NUM AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, RO_QTY AS RO_QTY, RO_AMT AS RO_AMT, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK , CENTER_CD AS PLANT FROM EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_IPGO_IF WHERE SEQ = $G_RS.SEQ$ AND MRO_PO_NO = '$G_RS.MRO_PO_NO$' AND PUR_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_LINE_NUM$' AND PUR_WH_NO = '$G_RS.PUR_WH_NO$' AND PUR_WH_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_WH_LINE_NUM$' AND PUR_WH_DT >= '20190801'
IF '$G_RS.FLAG$' = 'A' BEGIN UPDATE EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_IPGO_IF_R SET SEND_YN = 'Y' , SEND_DT = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , SEND_TM = REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),8),':','') WHERE SEQ = $G_RS.SEQ$ AND MRO_PO_NO = '$G_RS.MRO_PO_NO$' AND PUR_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_LINE_NUM$' AND PUR_WH_NO = '$G_RS.PUR_WH_NO$' AND PUR_WH_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_WH_LINE_NUM$'; END; ELSE BEGIN UPDATE EPRO_MRO.DBO.SAMYANGGROUP_IPGO_IF SET SEND_YN = 'Y' , SEND_DT = CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) , SEND_TM = REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),8),':','') WHERE SEQ = $G_RS.SEQ$ AND MRO_PO_NO = '$G_RS.MRO_PO_NO$' AND PUR_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_LINE_NUM$' AND PUR_WH_NO = '$G_RS.PUR_WH_NO$' AND PUR_WH_LINE_NUM = '$G_RS.PUR_WH_LINE_NUM$'; END;
